attempts.summary: Built redundant dual-uplink connectivity between node1 and node2 (each bonding its two parallel eth1/eth2 links into a balance-rr bond0 over a 172.20.0.0/31 transit), with node1/node2 each routing to their private-network hosts (node3 on 192.168.10.0/24, node4 on 192.168.20.0/24) via their eth3 interfaces. Verified node3<->node4 reachability persists with 0% loss when either individual link is fully failed (both ends down) and traffic uses both links simultaneously in steady state. Configuration was made persistent (systemd oneshot service on node1/node2, systemd-networkd .network file on node3/node4) and confirmed to survive a full reboot. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes with boot-id proof of restart and post-restart recovery verification.
